owner_symptom: After ~6 character browses, select preview disappears; battle may start with missing body (HUD/nameplate may remain).

root_causes.title: SubViewport texture staleness after full-roster browse cycles
root_causes.mechanism: Repeated configure/swap on a single FighterModel3D reused SubViewport→Sprite2D binding; on mobile the render target handle could remain non-null while producing zero visible meshes.
root_causes.fix: Wave020 refresh_viewport_texture() rebinds texture every heal; forced UPDATE_ONCE/ALWAYS every 7 swaps; select scene hard-recycles preview host every 7 browses.

root_causes.title: Rapid tile focus race superseding configure
root_causes.mechanism: Focus events could stack configure() calls before prior swap finished, leaving _loaded true but _visible_skeleton null.
root_causes.fix: Deferred _flush_preview_update() coalesces rapid focus; existing _preview_generation token preserved; post-failure _recreate_preview_model().

root_causes.title: Select preview not torn down before battle (regression guard)
root_causes.mechanism: Stale select SubViewport could leak into battle spawn path.
root_causes.fix: Preserved Wave018 _teardown_preview() on confirm/back; battle post-spawn ensure_visible_presentation + heal_visibility_if_needed.
